company.name: PoloTab
company.shortDescription: PoloTab is a software company that develops POS and management solutions for LatAm restaurants and Coffee Shops.
company.description:
PoloTab is a FoodTech and B2B SaaS platform built for restaurants, coffee shops, and food service businesses in Mexico. The platform helps businesses streamline their daily operations through an easy-to-use point-of-sale system that integrates sales, payments, inventory management, delivery integrations, a kitchen display system, and real-time business reports.
PoloTab enables restaurant owners and operators to centralize their operations, reduce manual work, improve visibility across their business, and make better decisions with real-time data.

productsAndServices.description: A point-of-sale system designed for restaurants and cafes to manage sales transactions quickly and intuitively, operable even without internet.
productsAndServices.name: PoloTab POS

productsAndServices.description: A real-time reporting tool that provides detailed sales, revenue, cost, and product performance data for restaurant management.
productsAndServices.name: PoloTab Reporting

productsAndServices.description: A system that consolidates orders from multiple delivery platforms like Uber Eats, Rappi, and DiDi Food into a single interface for easier management.
productsAndServices.name: PoloTab Delivery Apps Integration

productsAndServices.description: An automated inventory system that tracks products, manages stock levels, costs recipes, and provides real-time inventory reports for restaurants.
productsAndServices.name: PoloTab Inventory Management

productsAndServices.description: A billing system that generates consumption invoices instantly, allowing customers to enter their tax data and automating invoice issuance with QR code support.
productsAndServices.name: PoloTab Billing (Facturación)

productsAndServices.description: A system providing real-time data security, privacy, and traceability for sales, inventory, and financial information accessible via a secure portal.
productsAndServices.name: PoloTab Security and Data Management

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,704,625 to $11,334,084, a 2.41x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
